name: eudr-due-diligence-package-builder
title: EUDR Due-Diligence Package Builder: GeoJSON + Deforestation PDF
description: Turn a supplier CSV, KML or GeoJSON into an EUDR filing package: geometry repaired to the EU Information System rules, each plot screened against the JRC 2020 forest map and post-2020 tree-cover loss, an evidence PDF per plot, a clean GeoJSON and a DDS draft for the TRACES Operator API.
